name: Template Divided Damage Spell
displayText: Sacrifice up to three Units. For each Unit sacrificed, deal 1 damage to an enemy Unit or Commander. The damage may be divided among targets.

text.flavor: `divided` makes `amount` a total the chooser splits, so the selector under it is the pool the allocation draws from: `count: "all"` and `selection: "player_choice"` are required. A target takes its whole share as one hit. `previous_targets` counts what the step before resolved with.
